6 Bedroom, 3 Bathroom, Study, Detached Family home 
Impressive property aon subastantial grounds 

Richard Todd and Leonard Wilson Keenan are delighted to present The Haven to the Rush Co Dublin property market. 
The Haven is an impressive and substantial six-bedroom detached family residence, superbly positioned on the highly sought-after South Shore Road in Rush, Co. Dublin. Enjoying an exceptional coastal setting, this beautiful family home is located just a stone’s throw from the beach and within close proximity of Rush Golf Club, offering the perfect combination of generous family accommodation, seaside living, and convenience.

On arrival, the property immediately makes an impression. A spacious driveway provides ample off-street parking for several cars, while the large, bright porch creates a welcoming introduction to the home. Double French doors open into an impressive entrance hallway, filled with natural light and featuring a beautiful staircase, setting the tone for the generous proportions and bright accommodation found throughout.

To the left of the hallway is a large, elegant living room with a feature fireplace and a beautiful bay window overlooking the front of the property. The large window allows natural light to fill the room, creating a bright and inviting space ideal for relaxing with family or entertaining guests.

Continuing through the hallway, you are welcomed into the heart of this exceptional home: a spacious, modern open-plan kitchen, dining, and second living area. This impressive space has been designed with modern family living in mind and provides the perfect setting for everyday life, family gatherings and entertaining. The kitchen offers an abundance of base and eye-level storage, while the generous dining and living areas provide excellent flexibility. A further bay window enhances the space and ensures the room is filled with natural light.

Just off the kitchen is a practical scullery area and a convenient downstairs WC. There is also a further versatile room which could be used as a family room, home office or study and enjoys direct access to the rear garden. This space offers excellent potential and could, depending on the requirements of the new owners, be separated to create a more private and self-contained area.

The ground floor accommodation is further enhanced by two generous double bedrooms. One of these bedrooms benefits from a walk-in wardrobe which has already been plumbed, offering the potential for an easy conversion to an en-suite bathroom should the new owners require it.

Moving upstairs, the impressive scale and flexibility of the accommodation continues with four further large and bright double bedrooms. The principal bedroom suite is particularly impressive, extending from the front to the rear of the property and offering exceptional space. This wonderful suite incorporates a large en-suite bathroom with his-and-hers sinks and a generous walk-in wardrobe. To the front of the property, there is an additional private space which could be used as a sitting room or private retreat, or alternatively could potentially be separated to create a seventh bedroom, depending on the needs of the new owners.

Two of the additional double bedrooms also benefit from walk-in wardrobes which have been plumbed, offering the potential for future conversion into en-suite bathrooms if desired. Completing the upstairs accommodation is a large family bathroom which has recently been upgraded and finished with quality sanitary ware, reflecting the standard of finish found throughout the home.

The Haven has been lovingly maintained and upgraded by its current owners and is presented in excellent condition. The property benefits from an excellent BER rating, while new, high-quality flooring has recently been completed throughout areas of the home, further enhancing the comfort and presentation of this substantial family residence.

To the rear, the property enjoys an exceptionally large private garden with the added benefit of side driveway access. This wonderful outdoor space provides an ideal setting for children to play and for family gatherings, barbecues and outdoor entertaining. A garden shed provides useful additional storage, while the generous size of the garden offers enormous potential for those seeking a substantial outdoor space.

The location of The Haven is truly exceptional. South Shore Road is one of the most desirable residential locations in Rush, with the beautiful coastline and South Beach just moments from the property. Rush offers a wonderful coastal lifestyle, with its beaches, scenic walks and outdoor amenities providing an ideal setting for families and those who enjoy an active lifestyle.

Golf enthusiasts will also appreciate the close proximity of Rush Golf Club, while the town itself offers an excellent range of local amenities including shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, pubs, sporting facilities and recreational amenities. Rush has become an increasingly popular location for families seeking the benefits of coastal living while remaining within convenient reach of Dublin City and the surrounding areas.

The property is also ideally located close to a selection of local schools and educational facilities, making it an excellent choice for families. A number of primary schools are available in the Rush area, along with secondary school facilities and childcare options.

Transport links are also excellent, with Rush and Lusk Railway Station providing regular commuter services towards Dublin City and along the northern commuter route. Local bus services offer further connectivity, while the nearby road network provides convenient access to Dublin Airport, Swords, the M1 and Dublin City Centre.

The popular seaside town of Skerries is also within easy reach and offers a further selection of excellent restaurants, cafés, boutiques, beaches, coastal walks and recreational facilities. The proximity to both Rush and Skerries allows the new owners to enjoy everything that this highly desirable part of North County Dublin has to offer.

The Haven represents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial and versatile detached family home in one of Rush’s most sought-after coastal locations. With six generous bedrooms, three bathrooms, extensive living accommodation, a home office or study, exceptional flexibility throughout and a large private rear garden, this impressive property offers everything required for modern family living.

Properties of this scale and calibre, particularly in such a desirable location close to the beach and golf club, rarely come to the market. 
Early viewing is highly recommended.
